about:
All Molded Plastics operates from Wallingford, Connecticut, where it was founded as a family-owned corporation. The company's history notes that operations began in the state, though a specific founding year is not disclosed. The business remains under family ownership and serves as a domestic manufacturing partner for custom plastic components.

The shop specializes in injection molding, compression molding, and transfer molding of both thermoplastic and thermoset compounds. It produces custom plastic parts, including large housings and covers molded in high-density polyethylene (HDPE), and offers finished-goods assembly services. The facility has expanded to accommodate larger injection molding machinery to meet growing customer demand.

All Molded Plastics works with a range of clients, notably nationally known distributors, supplying molded parts for various industrial and commercial applications. The company positions itself as a resource for American manufacturing, quoting projects from prototype through production runs.

The company emphasizes its role as a U.S.-based manufacturer, highlighting domestic production capabilities and a family-owned structure that supports responsive service.
